mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance(emp_id, month, absent_days, late_times, fine) VALUES(#{empId}, #{month}, #{absentDays}, #{lateTimes}, #{fine})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET emp_id = #{empId}, month = #{month}, absent_days = #{absentDays}, late_times = #{lateTimes}, fine = #{fine} WHERE id = #{id}
